name: beebole
label: Beebole
description: Time tracking and project management. Create companies, projects, people, and log time entries.

token.label: API Token
token.description:
To get your Beebole API token:

1. Log in to your Beebole account at https://beebole-apps.com
2. Go to **Customize → API Token**
3. Generate a new API token 
4. Copy the token and paste it below

Need help? See https://beebole.com/help/api

create_person.label: Create Person
create_person.description: Creates a new person in Beebole. An available license is required for the person to be active.

company.label: Company
company.description: The company this person belongs to.

name.label: Full Name
name.description: The full name of the person (e.g. "Jane Doe").

email.label: Email
email.description: Email address. Required if you want to invite the person to log in to Beebole.

invite.label: Send Invitation Email
invite.description: Send an invitation email so the person can log in to Beebole. Requires an email address.

userGroup.label: User Group
userGroup.description: The permission level for this person. "Employee" can log time; "Project Lead" can also manage projects; "Admin" has full access.

create_company.label: Create Company
create_company.description: Creates a new company (customer) in Beebole.

name.label: Company Name
name.description: The name of the company (customer) to create.

corporate.label: Internal Company
corporate.description: Enable if this company represents your own organization (internal/corporate) rather than a customer.

create_project.label: Create Project
create_project.description: Creates a new project under a company in Beebole.

company.label: Company
company.description: The company (customer) that owns this project.

name.label: Project Name
name.description: The name of the new project (e.g. "Website Redesign").

startDate.label: Start Date
startDate.description: The project start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-01-15"). Leave empty for no start date.

create_subproject.label: Create Subproject
create_subproject.description: Creates a new subproject under an existing project in Beebole.

company.label: Company
company.description: The company that owns the parent project.

project.label: Project
project.description: The project that will contain this subproject.

name.label: Subproject Name
name.description: The name of the new subproject (e.g. "Prototype", "Phase 1").

deactivate_subproject.label: Deactivate Subproject
deactivate_subproject.description: Marks a subproject as inactive in Beebole. Inactive subprojects are hidden from new time entries.

company.label: Company
company.description: The company that owns the project.

project.label: Project
project.description: The project containing the subproject to deactivate.
